Now there are some that are acting like Decoys!|[[Ruthie]] on Wave 13 ([[Competition Court]])|audio = AdidasMission2Wave13-1.ogg}} }} ==Description== The '''Decoy''' was a support enemy from the [[Backyard Legends Event]]. It had high health and average speed. When killed, it would explode and apply a 15% [[Range Debuff]] and 50% [[Fatigue Debuff]] to every tower in a range of 9, also dealing 400 damage to units. ==Appearance== The '''Decoy''' is a grey humanoid with a black and green soccer ball for a head. It wears a blue and green stripped polyester shirt, black shorts, black adidas shoes with green laces and has blue armbands. ==Mutation== ===Hard Mission 2=== {| class="tds-table align-center mw-collapsible mw-collapsed" style="width: 300px; margin: 0 auto" ! colspan="2" |Mutation |- !Percentage !Increase |- |10% |450 |- !Wave !Health |- |14 |4,950 |- |15 |5,400 |} ===Hard Mission 3=== {| class="tds-table align-center mw-collapsible mw-collapsed" style="width: 300px; margin: 0 auto" ! colspan="2" |Mutation |- !Percentage !Increase |- |10% |450 |- !Wave !Health |- |14 |4,950 |- |15 |5,400 |- |16 |5,850 |- |17 |6,300 |- |18 |6,750 |- |19 |7,200 |- |20 |7,650 |} ==Event Strategy== As this enemy only appears through [[Sandbox Mode|Sandbox]] mode, no strategy section is made for its current version. Instead, a strategy section for the one that appeared without [[Sandbox Mode|Sandbox]] mode in [[Backyard Legends Event]] is listed instead. *The [[Assassin]], [[Trapper]] or [[Militant]] can be used to take this down. **The [[Commander]] can be used to boost the DPS of your towers, also helping to partially mitigate its debuff. *Spreading apart your towers can help by reducing how many towers are affected by the explosion, though this is not necessary. ==Gallery== {{Gallery| {{GalleryHeader|Corpse Variants}} DecoyCorpse1.png|Second [[Corpse (Enemy)|Corpse]] variant, current version, first animation variant (22 May 2026 – Present) DecoyCorpse2.png|Second [[Corpse (Enemy)|Corpse]] variant, current version, second animation variant (22 May 2026 – Present) DecoyCorpse3.png|Second [[Corpse (Enemy)|Corpse]] variant, current version, 3rd animation variant (22 May 2026 – Present) {{GalleryHeader|Miscellaneous}} DecoyIconIG.png|'''Decoy''' on its [[Index]] icon. }} ==Trivia== *The '''Decoy''' is unaffected by enemy appearance [[modifiers]], such as [[Talk Like a Pirate Day]]. *The '''Decoy''' reuses the [[Boomer]]'s ability. ==Update History== *'''22 May 2026''' - [[v1.91.0]] **'''Decoy''' added. **{{Bug}} '''Decoy's''' [[Logbooks|Logbook]] description is completely empty. *'''5 June 2026''' - [[v2.0.0]] **{{Bugfix}} [[Logbooks|Logbook]] description has been corrected to no description available. *'''12 June 2026''' - [[V2.0.0|v2.0.9]] **'''Decoy''' removed from the main game, now appears exclusively in [[Sandbox Mode|Sandbox]] mode. {{CompetitionCourt|[[Crowd Pleaser]]|Wave 11|Decoy|Wave 13|[[Soccer Goal]]|Wave 15}} {{VictoryField|[[Crowd Pleaser]]|Wave 11|Decoy|Wave 13|[[Soccer Goal]]|Wave 14}} {{ZombieNavBox}}
